description: Tells Cameron's phone when an Echo Show 8 1st or 2nd gen (or a Show 8 with no generation in its title) is newly listed at Cash Converters. sensor.echo_show_8_on_cash_converters runs tools/ha/cashconverters_echo.py every 30 minutes; a listing is new when its code wasn't in the sensor's previous list. Tapping the alert, or its Open listing button, opens the listing. Added 2026-11-24.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] and trigger.to_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] }}

data.title: Echo Show 8 at Cash Converters
data.message: {{ repeat.item.title }} ({{ repeat.item.gen ~ ' gen' if repeat.item.gen != 'unknown' else 'gen not stated' }}) ${{ '%.0f' | format(repeat.item.price) }}{{ (' + $' ~ repeat.item.postage ~ ' postage') if repeat.item.postage else '' }}, {{ repeat.item.store }}
